primary.row_set: images of the val BI-RADS comparison set that this model emits a prediction for, after dropping BI-RADS 0
primary.row_set_note: 85 of 209 comparison-set images. A view-fusion model predicts per PAIR and its table carries crop A's meta columns, so it covers only images that (a) have a counterpart view in the pair store and (b) are the A-side of that pair. The BI-RADS anchor quoted here (0.8900) is recomputed on these same rows and is NOT the whole-comparison-set anchor. Quote the two together or neither.
